To calculate the effective porosity (phi_eff), use the formula:

$$
\phi_{\text{eff}} = \phi_{\text{total}} \times (1 - V_{\text{sh}})
$$

Given:
- $\phi_{\text{total}} = 0.29$
- $V_{\text{sh}} = 0.18$

$$
\phi_{\text{eff}} = 0.29 \times (1 - 0.18) = 0.29 \times 0.82 = 0.2378
$$

The effective porosity is **0.2378** (as a fraction).
